PROP-01b-partial3-inv-036.text: Reserves must never exceed total assets: cash + totalBorrows >= totalReserves.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-036.assertion: forall market m: getCash(m) + m.totalBorrows >= m.totalReserves

locations.note: Line 313: asserts self.cash >= self.cash_reserve.ceil() after every withdrawal, enforcing reserves <= cash invariant
Line 197: asserts self.cash - self.cash_reserve.ceil() > amount before borrow; prevents reserves from exceeding cash
